findings.rule: Threads running into a shoulder require an undercut, relief groove, or thread runout.
findings.reasoning: F7 explicitly states the external M20 thread runs up to the shoulder with no undercut/relief groove, so standard threading tooling cannot produce a complete thread form at the shoulder.
findings.correction: Add an undercut/relief groove or specify a thread runout/lead-in, or move the thread termination away from the shoulder.

findings.rule: Heat treatment must be specified or referenced consistently in the title block and notes.
findings.reasoning: The title block heat_treatment is '---' while N1 requires case hardening to 55-60 HRC and case depth 0.8-2 mm, creating a missing/contradictory heat-treatment reference.
findings.correction: Enter the case-hardening requirement in drawing.heat_treatment or add a clear REF NOTE to N1 in the title block.

findings.rule: Electroplated coatings on high-hardness case-hardened steel require hydrogen-embrittlement control or a suitable alternative.
findings.reasoning: 20MnCr5 is case hardened to 55-60 HRC per N1, and trivalent zinc plating (I.Z.B.P.) can introduce hydrogen; no hydrogen-embrittlement relief/baking note is given.
findings.correction: Add a post-plating hydrogen-embrittlement relief/bake requirement per the applicable plating standard, or specify a coating/process suitable for 55-60 HRC case-hardened steel.

findings.rule: Functional bore/fit diameters must have a tolerance or fit class.
findings.reasoning: The part is a pin sleeve, and F2 identifies the inner bore as ⌀20 (D4/D12) with no tolerance; the separate ⌀12 H7 (D3) is not clearly associated with the bore, leaving the functional fit undefined.
findings.correction: Identify the functional bore and assign an appropriate fit/tolerance, or clearly mark the ⌀20 diameter as non-functional.
